title: 第5章 反吸吕玉清第6章 吕玉清的约定
content_zh:
;;
“不…我的修为！我的灵力！停下！快停下！”
吕玉清娇躯剧颤，美目中满是惊恐。
她能清晰地感觉到，自己苦修数百载、引以为傲的通天境修为，正如退潮般飞速流逝！
这种眼睁睁看着自己力量消失的感觉，比杀了她还要难受！
与此同时，周尘的气息却在节节攀升，直接将吸收来的阴元灵力尽数炼化。
原本刚刚突破的凝元境修为，此刻正以肉眼可见的速度暴涨！
“怎么回事？！这到底是什么邪功！？”
吕玉清心神俱裂。
她纵横青州，创立玉女宫，采补的男子没有一百也有八十，从来只有她吸干别人，何曾想过自己也会有沦为他人炉鼎的一天？！
而且还是被一个不久前还是她掌中玩物、随意采补的少年反制！
这巨大的反差和羞辱感几乎让她崩溃。
“小...小弟弟...”
她强撑笑意，声音酥媚中带着哀求：
“姐姐知道错了...你放过姐姐好不好？姐姐以后一定好好疼你...”
周尘冷笑一声，手上力道丝毫不减：
“你这妖女，还想骗我？”
他非但没有丝毫怜悯，反而全力催动《九劫纯阳经》。
对于这个险些将他吸成人干、还想将他永世囚禁为鼎器的女人，他心中唯有恨意和利用，绝无半分同情。
“不！不要！周尘…公子…饶了我！我知道错了！求求你停下！”

吕玉清彻底慌了，感受到修为跌落的趋势加快，她再也顾不得什么宫主尊严，颤声哀求起来，美眸中泪光闪烁，试图唤起周尘的怜惜。
周尘眼神冷漠如冰，丝毫没有怜悯之意。
饶了她？
若非羲和女帝和阴阳塔，自己早已是一具枯骨！
此刻她求饶，不过是力量反噬下的恐惧罢了，岂能有半分真心？
“饶了你？”周尘冷笑。
“刚才你采补我，害我修为尽失、经脉欲裂时，可曾想过手下留情？”
“若非我另有际遇，早已被你榨干！现在求饶？晚了！”
话音未落，周尘大手猛地一扯。
“刺啦——！”
吕玉清身上薄如蝉翼的素白纱衣应声而裂，紧接着一件件华贵的衣物散落一地。
“啊！你…你要干嘛？！”
content_en:
;;
"No...my cultivation! My spiritual power! Stop! Stop!"
Lu Yuqing's delicate body trembled violently, her beautiful eyes full of fear.
She could clearly feel that the cultivation of the Tongtian realm, which she had practiced hard for hundreds of years and was proud of, was passing by as fast as the ebbing tide!
This feeling of watching one's own power disappear is even more uncomfortable than killing her!
At the same time, Zhou Chen's aura was rising steadily, directly refining all the Yin Yuan spiritual power he had absorbed.
The cultivation level of the Condensing Yuan Realm that had just been broken through was now skyrocketing at a speed visible to the naked eye!
"What's going on?! What kind of evil skill is this!?"
Lu Yuqing was heartbroken.
She traveled across Qingzhou and founded the Jade Girl Palace. The number of men she collected ranged from a hundred to eighty. She had always been the only one who sucked others dry. How could she have thought that one day she would become someone else's furnace? !
And she was countered by a young boy who was just a plaything in her palm not long ago and picked supplements at will!
The huge contrast and humiliation almost made her collapse.
"Little... little brother..."
She forced a smile, and her voice was sweet and pleading:
"Sister knows that she was wrong... Can you let her go? I will definitely love you well in the future..."
Zhou Chen sneered, his strength in his hands not diminishing at all:
"You witch, you still want to lie to me?"
Not only did he show no mercy, but he used all his strength to activate the "Nine Tribulations Pure Yang Sutra".
For this woman who almost sucked him to death and wanted to imprison him as a cauldron forever, he only had hatred and use in his heart, and absolutely no sympathy.
"No! Don't! Zhou Chen... Young Master... spare me! I know I was wrong! Please stop!"
Lu Yuqing was completely panicked. She felt that the decline in cultivation was accelerating. She no longer cared about the dignity of the palace master. She began to plead with a trembling voice. Tears shone in her beautiful eyes, trying to arouse Zhou Chen's pity.
Zhou Chen's eyes were as cold as ice, showing no mercy at all.
Spare her?
If it weren't for Empress Xihe and the Yin-Yang Tower, I would have been a withered skeleton!
At this moment, she was begging for mercy, but it was just the fear caused by the backlash of power. How could she be half sincere?
"Spare you?" Zhou Chen sneered.
"When you harvested me and caused me to lose all my cultivation and my meridians were about to burst, did you ever think of showing mercy?"
"If I hadn't had another chance, I would have been squeezed dry by you! Begging for mercy now? It's too late!"
Before he finished speaking, Zhou Chen pulled hard with his big hand.
"Stab-!"
Lu Yuqing's plain white gauze clothes, as thin as cicada wings, tore apart immediately, and pieces of luxurious clothes were scattered on the floor.
"Ah! What...what are you going to do?!"
